svg.title: Codex Micro enlarged perfboard and component pin orientation
svg.text: Top/component side. Column A is at the left; row 01 is at the bottom. Dashed bridges are on the underside, seen through the board.
Crop of the 4 x 6 cm board: A-K, rows 03-12.
Each hole is isolated until you deliberately join it.
NOTCH points toward the column letters / higher row numbers.
Looking underneath mirrors left and right. Locate the holes from above first.
Solid line = insulated wire on top. Short dashed line = bent lead + solder below.
Small X = intentionally unused chip output; leave unconnected.
SN74AHCT125N - the small chip translates only the LED data.
THE TWO COMPONENTS ALREADY ON THE BOARD
330 ohm resistor: B8 to B12. B8-C8-D8 and A12-B12 are bridges.
104 ceramic capacitor: D11 to G11. D11-D10 and G11-G10 are bridges.
The capacitor crosses power and ground; it does not short them together.
100 uF capacitor near the start of the light chain: + to 5V; stripe to GND.
More lights: each needs 5V + GND, plus data from the preceding DOUT.
Joystick, touch and indicators share GND. Use a separate soldered junction
from the spare GND hole; the illustration does not assign new perfboard holes.
HOW TO READ THE REST OF THE KEYBOARD
A key closes a column-to-row path.
Diode black band faces its row.
Both Voice switches get a diode.
Joystick pads, from underside: X, 3V, Y, GND.
All 5V pads share power; all GND pads share ground.
Only DATA chains: OUT of one > IN of the next.
Pixel pads: underside, arrows left to right, 5V at top.
References checked against this project and manufacturer documentation:
NeoPixels: adafruit.com/product/4776 | Encoder: adafruit.com/product/377 | Joystick: sparkfun.com/thumb-slide-joystick.html
Project source: data/wiring.json + wiring-guide/connections.json + downloads/firmware/code.py on codexmicro.diy.
A3 / A4 here are PERFBOARD coordinates, not the analog pins on the KB2040.
Matches the website firmware and bench perfboard map. Component positions are spread out for clarity; this is not a case-fit drawing or confirmation of your soldered build.
